materials.text: Certificate of HSK Except those graduated from a Chinese university Photocopy of valid passport With name, passport number & expiration date, and photo included Passport photo A recent passport-sized photo of the applicant Postgraduate school transcript Master's degree diploma Graduation certificate in languages other than Chinese or English should be translated into Chinese or English and be certified by notarization. Letter of recommendation From professor or associate professor or equivalents Study plan Including study purpose, research interest and research plan in brief. Master’s Paper Abstract
